창작·집필 안내: About the Story and Its Writing
『연이의 운명 노벨』은 Code Destiny가 직접 쓰고 그린 창작 소: Yeoni's Destiny Novel is an original work written and illustrated by Code Destiny. All characters and events are fictional and have no connection to real people or organizations.
이야기의 무대는 사주 명리학의 십성, 자미두수의 열두 궁, 숙요 27수라: The setting draws on real traditions: the Ten Stars of Four Pillars astrology, the twelve palaces of Zi Wei Dou Shu, and the 27 lunar mansions of Sukuyo.
